description: This is a shell script that sets up environment variables, ensures necessary directories exist, and runs Playwright tests for a native application project, capturing and reporting the test results.

methods.name: set -euo pipefail
methods.description: Configures shell options for strict error handling and undefined variable detection

methods.name: set +e
methods.description: Temporarily disables immediate exit on error to allow command execution regardless of failure

methods.name: set -e
methods.description: Re-enables immediate exit on error after critical command execution
